context.zh: 成熟 M 頂與頸線區存在，價格快速下跌至重要支撐後，交易者尋找類晨星反轉結構。
context.en: A mature M-top and neckline existed. After aggressive downside movement reached important support, the trader looked for a Morning-Star-like reversal structure.

trade_thesis.zh: 理想模型是在支撐區出現 H1 晨星／十字星拒絕並以次一時段向上跳空提早試單；真實交易因需出海無法監控，實際較晚在 H1 EMA15 附近進場。
trade_thesis.en: The ideal model is an early probe after an H1 Morning Doji Star rejection at support and a next-session bullish gap. In the real trade, offshore work prevented monitoring, so entry occurred later around H1 EMA15.

reason.zh: 原偏好在 H1 反轉確認後進場；實際因出海無法監控，延後至 H1 EMA15 附近才進場。
reason.en: The preferred entry was after H1 reversal confirmation; the actual entry was delayed until the H1 EMA15 area because offshore work prevented monitoring.

reason.zh: 依相關 H1 結構低點保護；精確停損價格尚未可靠還原。
reason.en: Protected beneath the relevant H1 structural low; the exact stop price has not been reliably recovered.

trailing_method.zh: 停損依 H1 已確認市場結構低點逐步上移。
trailing_method.en: The stop was progressively raised behind confirmed H1 market-structure lows.

reason.zh: 第一個確認 H1 Higher Low 後上移。
reason.en: Raised after the first confirmed H1 higher low.

reason.zh: 第二個確認 H1 Higher Low 後上移。
reason.en: Raised after the second confirmed H1 higher low.

reason.zh: 第三個確認 H1 Higher Low 後上移。
reason.en: Raised after the third confirmed H1 higher low.

reason.zh: 最終觸及 H1 結構移動停損出場，交易已知獲利，但精確數字尚未驗證。
reason.en: The position eventually exited on the H1 structural trailing stop. The trade is known to have closed profitably, but exact figures are not validated.

ema15_context.zh: 實際進場約在 H1 EMA15 區域；精確均線值未知。
ema15_context.en: Actual entry occurred around H1 EMA15; the exact moving-average value is unknown.

ema50_context.zh: H1 EMA50 的精確位置與數值尚未還原。
ema50_context.en: The exact H1 EMA50 location and value have not been recovered.

higher_timeframe_context.zh: 未取得足夠資料以可靠描述較高週期背景。
higher_timeframe_context.en: Insufficient evidence is available to describe the higher-timeframe context reliably.

outcome_summary.zh: 已知獲利；精確 R、百分比與成交價格均待原始紀錄驗證。
outcome_summary.en: Known profitable; exact R, percentage, and execution prices await validation from original records.

notes.zh: 真實案例保留較晚進場的不完美，不能反過來修改 Phase 1 的理想早期跳空進場模型。
notes.en: The real case preserves the imperfect late entry and must not reshape the approved Phase 1 early-gap ideal model.

what_worked.zh: 下跌後等待重要支撐的反轉結構，並以 H1 結構低點管理停損。
what_worked.en: The trader waited for a reversal structure at important support and managed risk behind H1 structural lows.

what_was_imperfect.zh: 因出海無法監控而錯過原偏好確認點，實際進場較晚且靠近 H1 EMA15。
what_was_imperfect.en: Offshore work prevented monitoring, so the preferred confirmation entry was missed and actual entry occurred later near H1 EMA15.

invalidation.zh: 支撐反轉失敗並有效跌破結構低點，或向上跳空沒有延續。
invalidation.en: Failure of the support reversal with a valid break of the structural low, or no follow-through after the bullish gap.

a_plus.zh: M 頂跌破後抵達主要支撐、晨星十字星拒絕、次一時段向上跳空並可用緊停損。
a_plus.en: M-top breakdown into major support, Morning Doji Star rejection, next-session bullish gap, and a tight defensible stop.

downgrade.zh: 晚追至壓力區、停損過寬、沒有明確支撐或反轉後缺乏延續。
downgrade.en: Late entry into resistance, an overly wide stop, no clear support, or weak follow-through after reversal.
